name: DKAN
description: An open-data portal for Drupal: publish, store, harvest and serve datasets with a datastore and a metadata API.
project_description:
The DKAN module enables organizations and individuals to build open data portals in Drupal. Inspired by CKAN , it provides powerful open source tools for publishing and cataloging datasets and their metadata.

 Major features include:

 
 A JSON-based metadata system, allowing you to create and store complex, nested metadata structures 
 Both a fully-featured REST API and an endlessly customizable web UI for editing metadata (via the JSON Form Widget ) 
 A datastore which imports tabular data files into database tables and exposes them for querying with a JSON API 
 A harvest system that loads metadata from external catalogs and other sources (like an RSS reader for datasets) 
 
 For full project documentation, visit our documentation site .

 For issues and pull requests, visit our Github project .

 For a look at what a data catalog with a decoupled react frontend built on the DKAN APIs might look like, visit our demo site .

 
 Development, merge requests and issue management for DKAN currently happen at our GitHub project . Starting with DKAN 4.0, releases have moved to Drupal.org. Issues and MRs will move here in the future.
